summary: Practise trustee oversight, compliance mapping, risk registers, and nonprofit controls. Explore the five-day course outline.
lede: Governance training for nonprofit organizations helps executives, compliance officers, finance managers, and board secretaries document oversight and legal duties. Participants practise mapping obligations and board responsibilities, assessing risks, and testing controls for restricted funds and conflicts of interest. They also develop safeguarding escalation routes and board reports to help monitor compliance evidence.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for people who prepare board decisions, maintain nonprofit controls, or advise trustees on duties, risks, and records.
modules: Nonprofit Trustee Duties and Board Records
COSO Internal Controls and Restricted Funds
prerequisites: Basic familiarity with nonprofit operations, board papers, or administrative records is useful. No legal qualification is required; the course addresses compliance mapping and governance practice rather than providing legal advice.
